title: Symmetric and Isotypic Hilbert Series for Symmetric Ideals
summary: An ideal in a polynomial ring is symmetric if it is invariant under any permutation of variables. In this paper, we define and study the symmetric and isotypic Hilbert series for symmetric ideals in a polynomial ring with countably many variables. The symmetric Hilbert series is the limit of the Hilbert series of the invariant parts of the finite truncated quotients, while the isotypic Hilbert series records stable multiplicities of irreducible symmetric-group representations for each degree.
